If you’re only using the STAR method in interviews… you’re already behind.

As an Ex-Google recruiter, I’ve watched thousands of candidates lose offers, not because they weren’t qualified, but because their answers sounded like everyone else’s.

In this video, I’ll show you the new framework top candidates use to stand out, one that makes your answers sound confident, strategic, and leadership-ready from the very first sentence.

 You’ll learn:

- Why STAR interview answers fail in senior or leadership roles
- The exact 4-step framework (HERO) I use to coach my clients into FAANG and Fortune 100 companies
- Real before-and-after examples so you can reframe your own answers today

Whether you’re interviewing for a promotion or your next big tech role, this video will show you how to talk like a decision-maker, not just a doer.
